The claim states that the technique involves handling non-homogeneous voxels in a single rectangular space by creating specific textures for each heterogeneous plane. Source [S2] explicitly states: 'in any space where you have non-homogenous voxels but a single rectangular space, you will need to create a new texture specifically to map onto that plane... and every other heterogenous plane.' This directly supports the factual content of the claim.
